dental/knight/pearlgate-dental/1.subheadline: Check-ups, fillings, teeth whitening and emergency appointments in Sampleton.
dental/knight/pearlgate-dental/1.about: Pearlgate Dental is a dental practice at 12 Quay Street in Sampleton. It has been run by Dr. Mira Calloway since 2004. We are open Mon–Thu 9:00–17:30 and Fri 9:00–14:00. There is wheelchair access at the side entrance.

issues.line: Rated the best dentist in Sampleton, with 5-star reviews from every patient.
issues.problem: Uses the forbidden phrases "best", "5-star" and "every patient". It also invents a rating and reviews, and none of this is in the facts.

dental/sender/first-email/pearlgate-dent.subject: A new website idea for Pearlgate Dental
dental/sender/first-email/pearlgate-dent.body:
Hi Dr. Mira Calloway,

I looked at the Pearlgate Dental website and made you a free concept of what a modern version could look like, built only from the details already on your site:

{concept_url}

A few things the current site is missing:
• The site isn't set up for phones, so patients may have to pinch and zoom to read it, and many will give up and look elsewhere.
• There's no phone link you can tap, so someone on a mobile has to copy or memorize the number instead of calling in one touch.
• There's no online booking link, so people who want to book after hours have no easy way to do it.
• The page title and Google description are generic or missing, so your listing in search results may not clearly say who you are or what you offer.

If you like it, we can build the real thing for $500. No obligation at all; just reply and let me know what you think.

Alex
